whyNavDhan.heading: Why Choose NavDhan?
whyNavDhan.body: A structured application flow that keeps lender decisions and final terms explicit.

reasons.bodyKey: Complete the required business, applicant, and loan details in a guided flow.
Application data is encrypted in transit and sensitive fields are encrypted at rest.
Review the lender's rate, fees, tenure, and repayment terms before accepting an offer.
Upload the documents required for your business constitution and application stage.
Contact the support team by email if you need help with the application.
Available repayment schedules depend on lender assessment and the final offer.

emiCalculator.heading: Plan Your Finances
emiCalculator.intro: Use this illustrative calculator to explore repayment scenarios. Actual amounts, rates, tenures, fees, eligibility, and approval are set by the lender and may differ.

finalCta.heading: Ready to grow your business?

hero.heading: Built by people who believe in small business.

mission.heading: Calm, credible credit for every small business.
mission.body: We believe MSMEs deserve a lending experience that is honest, respectful, and fast. NavDhan exists to make that the default.

items.title: Empathy
